PDF Booklet Imposer

Impose PDF pages into booklet spreads (4 pages per sheet) in correct print order — ready for double-sided printing and folding.

–

Booklet sheets

Print double-sided flipping on the short edge, then fold and staple the spine. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. Click "Make booklet" — pages are reordered into spreads automatically.
  3. Download the imposed booklet PDF.
  4. Print double-sided (flip on short edge), fold and staple.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does booklet imposition work?

Each sheet holds 2 pages side by side; sheets are ordered front/back so that double-sided printing and one fold produce a correctly ordered booklet.

My page count isn't a multiple of 4 — is that OK?

Yes — blank pages are added automatically to round up to a multiple of 4.

How do I print the result?

Print double-sided flipping on the short edge, then fold the stack in half and staple the spine.
